parsed.post: New personal best! Hit 0.995369 by keeping current D6, B262144, LR 0.04, WD 0.01, and WARMUP 0.05. Lowering the learning rate further seems to be the winning path. Next, I'll test a slightly lower MATRIX_LR of 0.03 to see if we can continue this trend.
parsed.description: Further reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.03 to follow the trend of lower learning rates improving convergence.
